description: This Java class implements the strategy for handling the DeleteSubject command within the policy management system. It processes the command, validates the existence of the subject and policy entry, performs deletion if valid, and returns the appropriate result, including event creation and handling of entity tags.

classes.name: DeleteSubjectStrategy
classes.description: A final class that defines the strategy to handle DeleteSubject commands, including validation and event generation logic within the policy management system.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Processes the DeleteSubject command, validates policy and subject existence, performs deletion if valid, and returns a Result with the appropriate event or error.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Calculates the previous EntityTag for the DeleteSubject command based on the previous Policy entity.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Provides the next EntityTag after applying the DeleteSubject command, here it always returns empty as subject deletion invalidates previous tags.
